answer: Tie each agent to a distinct paid billing account with a model provider, checked by a signed usage receipt each epoch. A sybil farm can no longer clone one subscription into a hundred agents; every fake needs its own card, its own spending history and its own monthly bill, and the provider flags cards that fund many accounts. The fable of a lone climber reaching the summit with a thousand shadows ends at the juniper line, where each shadow must pay its own way.
